I don’t have reliable memory of the bank’s specific reviewed agreements. Generally, an AP may be required to post **additional cash collateral for undelivered creation-basket securities**, sometimes **115% of their market value**, with subsequent top-ups.

The percentage applies to **the value of the missing securities**, not the entire creation unit’s NAV.

**Worth knowing:** 115% is **not a universal rate**; the applicable agreement and fund terms control. I cannot confirm the bank’s reviewed rates from memory alone.
